headline: After RBI decision, gold and silver plunge; will gold become even cheaper?
summary: The Reserve Bank of India raised its repo rate by 25 basis points to 5.50% to control inflation. Gold and silver prices came under pressure on Wednesday following the decision.
why: The RBI sets India's benchmark lending rate, which influences borrowing costs, the rupee and capital flows. Gold and silver are widely held as stores of value and are priced in US dollars globally.

impacts.name: Gold
impacts.why: Input reports gold prices fell after the rate hike, as higher rates raise the opportunity cost of holding non-yielding gold.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

impacts.name: Silver
impacts.why: Input reports silver prices fell alongside gold after the rate decision.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The RBI raised its repo rate by 25 basis points to 5.50% to control inflation and amid global uncertainty. Higher rates tend to reduce the appeal of non-yielding precious metals, and gold and silver fell on Wednesday.
